verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe the local dev workflow: Git sync clones a repo you own, developers work locally in their own IDE, commit and push, and changes sync back into Lovable (lovable-docs-9, lovable-docs-14, lovable-docs-33, lovable-docs-20). This directly matches the story of editing locally with own tooling and pushing back. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the bidirectional sync works reliably in practice (community evidence focuses on other topics, not this specific round-trip workflow).
